## 1) Load GEO Datasets

```{r load-datasets}
options(timeout = 600000)
load_GEO_dataset <- function(gse_id) {
  gse <- getGEO(gse_id, GSEMatrix = TRUE)[[1]]
  expr <- exprs(gse)
  pheno <- pData(gse)
  stopifnot(colnames(expr) == rownames(pheno))
  
  tissue_col <- grep("tissue|characteristics|source|description",
                     colnames(pheno), ignore.case=TRUE, value=TRUE)[1]
  
  labels <- ifelse(grepl("tumor|cancer|malignant", pheno[, tissue_col], ignore.case=TRUE), "Tumor",
                   ifelse(grepl("normal|control|healthy", pheno[, tissue_col], ignore.case=TRUE), "Normal", NA))
  labels <- factor(labels, levels=c("Normal","Tumor"))
  
  list(expr=expr, pheno=pheno, labels=labels)
}

datasets <- list(
  Lung    = "GSE19804",
  Breast  = "GSE15852",
  Liver   = "GSE112790",
  Gastric = "GSE13911"
)

loaded_data <- lapply(datasets, load_GEO_dataset)
```

## 2) PREPROCESSING

```{r split-preprocess}
library(caret)
library(DMwR)       # for SMOTE
library(sva)        # for ComBat
set.seed(1996)

split_data <- list()

for (nm in names(loaded_data)) {
  cat("\n=== Processing dataset:", nm, "===\n")
  
  # --- Extract features and labels
  X <- loaded_data[[nm]]$expr
  y <- loaded_data[[nm]]$labels
  
  # --- Train/test split
  set.seed(1996)
  train_idx <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
  X_train <- X[, train_idx, drop = FALSE]
  X_test  <- X[, -train_idx, drop = FALSE]
  y_train <- y[train_idx]
  y_test  <- y[-train_idx]
  
  # --- Variance filtering
  vars <- apply(X_train, 1, var)
  keep_genes <- vars > quantile(vars, 0.2)
  X_train <- X_train[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  X_test  <- X_test[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # --- Balancing
  df_train <- data.frame(t(X_train), Class = y_train)
  
  if (nm == "Liver") {
    set.seed(1996)
    df_train$Class <- as.factor(df_train$Class)
    df_bal <- SMOTE(Class ~ ., data = df_train, perc.over = 100, k = 5)
    
  } else if (nm == "Gastric") {
    set.seed(1996)
    df_bal <- upSample(
      x = df_train[, -ncol(df_train)],
      y = df_train$Class,
      yname = "Class"
    )
    
  } else {
    df_bal <- df_train
  }
  
  # --- Prepare final train matrices
  X_train <- t(as.matrix(df_bal[, -ncol(df_bal)]))
  y_train <- df_bal$Class
  
  # --- Batch correction (if batch info exists)
  pheno_train <- loaded_data[[nm]]$pheno[colnames(X_train), , drop = FALSE]
  pheno_test  <- loaded_data[[nm]]$pheno[colnames(X_test), , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (!is.null(pheno_train$batch) && length(unique(pheno_train$batch)) > 1) {
    mod_train <- model.matrix(~1, pheno_train)
    X_train <- ComBat(
      dat = X_train,
      batch = pheno_train$batch,
      mod = mod_train,
      par.prior = TRUE,
      prior.plots = FALSE
    )
    
    if (!is.null(pheno_test$batch)) {
      X_test <- ComBat(
        dat = X_test,
        batch = pheno_test$batch,
        mod = mod_train,
        par.prior = TRUE,
        prior.plots = FALSE,
        ref.batch = pheno_train$batch[1]
      )
    }
  }
  
  # --- Store processed data
  split_data[[nm]] <- list(
    train_expr   = X_train,
    test_expr    = X_test,
    train_labels = y_train,
    test_labels  = y_test
  )
  
  cat("Finished processing", nm, "\n")
}
```

## 3) mRMR Feature Selection

```{r mrmr-selection}
## -----------------------------
## Clean mRMR prefilter function
## -----------------------------
library(mRMRe)
library(caret)

mrmr_prefilter <- function(X_train, y_train,
                           top_features_per_chunk = 100,
                           final_num_features = 1000,
                           chunk_size = 5000,
                           target_limit = 46340,
                           cv_folds = 5,
                           seed = 1996) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  options(mRMRe.seed = seed)
  # --- Step 1: Variance filtering to reduce extreme dimensions for mRMR to run without returning error
  feature_vars <- apply(X_train, 2, var)
  selected <- names(feature_vars)
  quantiles <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.02)
  for (q in quantiles) {
    cutoff <- quantile(feature_vars, probs = q)
    sel <- names(feature_vars)[feature_vars >= cutoff]
    if (length(sel) <= target_limit) {
      selected <- sel
      break
    }
  }

  # --- Step 2: Split features into chunks
  feature_chunks <- split(selected, ceiling(seq_along(selected) / chunk_size))
  
  # --- Step 3: CV folds
  folds <- createFolds(y_train, k = cv_folds, list = TRUE, returnTrain = TRUE)
  fold_features <- vector("list", length(folds))
  
  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    cat("Processing mRMR Fold:", i, "\n")
    
    tr_idx <- folds[[i]]
    te_idx <- setdiff(seq_along(y_train), tr_idx)
    
    Xtr <- X_train[tr_idx, selected, drop = FALSE]
    ytr <- y_train[tr_idx]
    
    sel_from_chunks <- c()
    
    for (chunk in feature_chunks) {
      feats <- intersect(chunk, colnames(Xtr))
      if (length(feats) < 2) next
      
      dfc <- as.data.frame(Xtr[, feats, drop = FALSE])
      dfc$target <- as.numeric(ytr)
      
      dm <- tryCatch(mRMRe::mRMR.data(data = dfc), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(dm)) next
      
      res <- tryCatch(
        mRMRe::mRMR.classic(data = dm,
                            target_indices = ncol(dfc),
                            feature_count = min(top_features_per_chunk, length(feats))),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(res)) next
      
      idx <- mRMRe::solutions(res)[[1]]
      sel_from_chunks <- c(sel_from_chunks, mRMRe::featureNames(dm)[idx])
    }
    
    # --- Fallback if too few features
    if (length(sel_from_chunks) < 2) {
      warning(paste("Fold", i, ": too few features, fallback to variance-selected"))
      sel_from_chunks <- selected
    }
    
    # --- Aggregate features across chunks
    df_agg <- as.data.frame(Xtr[, sel_from_chunks, drop = FALSE])
    df_agg$target <- as.numeric(ytr)
    
    dm2 <- mRMRe::mRMR.data(data = df_agg)
    final_k <- min(final_num_features, length(sel_from_chunks))
    
    res2 <- mRMRe::mRMR.classic(data = dm2, target_indices = ncol(df_agg), feature_count = final_k)
    fidx <- mRMRe::solutions(res2)[[1]]
    final_feats <- mRMRe::featureNames(dm2)[fidx]
    
    fold_features[[i]] <- final_feats
  }
  
  # --- Step 4: Aggregate across folds (features selected in majority of folds)
  all_feats <- unlist(fold_features)
  feat_tab <- table(all_feats)
  final_selected <- names(feat_tab[feat_tab >= ceiling(cv_folds / 2)]) # majority vote
  
  return(final_selected)
}

## -----------------------------
## Apply mRMR prefilter to all datasets
## -----------------------------
mRMR_results <- list()
for (nm in names(split_data)) {
  cat("\n=== Running mRMR prefilter for dataset:", nm, "===\n")
  Xtr <- t(split_data[[nm]]$train_expr) # mRMRe expects samples as rows
  ytr <- split_data[[nm]]$train_labels
  mRMR_results[[nm]] <- mrmr_prefilter(Xtr, ytr,
                                        top_features_per_chunk = 100,
                                        final_num_features = 1000,
                                        chunk_size = 5000,
                                        cv_folds = 5)
  cat("Selected features:", length(mRMR_results[[nm]]), "\n")
}
```

## 4) Hybrid Feature Selection Methods

````{r}
library(caret)
library(mixOmics)
library(glmnet)

# -----------------------------
# Function: Run Hybrid Method Safely
# -----------------------------
run_hybrid_selection <- function(x_train, y_train, method, ncomp = 5, keepX = 50) {
  
  x_train <- as.matrix(x_train)
  y_train <- factor(y_train)
  
  if(ncol(x_train) < 2) {
    warning(paste("Too few features for method:", method))
    return(character(0))
  }
  
  switch(method,
         "sPLS" = {
           ncomp <- min(ncomp, ncol(x_train)-1)
           keepX <- rep(min(keepX, floor(ncol(x_train)/ncomp)), ncomp)
           model <- mixOmics::splsda(x_train, y_train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX)
           features <- unique(unlist(apply(model$loadings$X, 2, 
                                           function(x) names(x)[abs(x) > 1e-6])))
         },
         "RFE" = {
           ctrl <- rfeControl(functions = rfFuncs, method = "cv", number = 5)
           sizes <- c(20,50,100)
           sizes <- sizes[sizes <= ncol(x_train)]
           if(length(sizes) == 0) sizes <- min(10, ncol(x_train))
           model <- rfe(x_train, y_train, sizes = sizes, rfeControl = ctrl)
           features <- predictors(model)
         },
         "LASSO" = {
           cv_model <- cv.glmnet(x_train, y_train, family = "binomial", alpha = 1)
           coefs <- coef(cv_model, s = "lambda.min")
           features <- rownames(coefs)[as.vector(coefs != 0)]
           features <- setdiff(features, "(Intercept)")
         })
  
  return(features)
}

# -----------------------------
# Hybrid Feature Selection Across All Datasets
# -----------------------------
methods <- c("sPLS", "RFE", "LASSO")
hybrid_results <- list(sPLS = list(), RFE = list(), LASSO = list())

for(nm in names(split_data)) {
  cat("\n=== Processing dataset:", nm, "===\n")
  
  # Ensure feature names are consistent
  rownames(split_data[[nm]]$train_expr) <- make.names(rownames(split_data[[nm]]$train_expr))
  rownames(split_data[[nm]]$test_expr)  <- make.names(rownames(split_data[[nm]]$test_expr))
  
  # Find common mRMR-selected features present in both train and test
  valid_feats <- intersect(mRMR_results[[nm]], rownames(split_data[[nm]]$train_expr))
  common_feats <- intersect(valid_feats, rownames(split_data[[nm]]$test_expr))
  
  if(length(common_feats) < 2) {
    warning("Too few common features for dataset:", nm)
    next
  }
  
  # Subset and transpose: samples x features
  x_train <- t(split_data[[nm]]$train_expr[common_feats, , drop = FALSE])
  x_test  <- t(split_data[[nm]]$test_expr[common_feats, , drop = FALSE])
  y_train <- split_data[[nm]]$train_labels
  y_test  <- split_data[[nm]]$test_labels
  
  cat("Number of features used:", ncol(x_train), "\n")
  
  # Run each hybrid method
  for(method in methods) {
    features <- run_hybrid_selection(x_train, y_train, method)
    hybrid_results[[method]][[nm]] <- features
    cat(method, "selected features:", length(features), "\n")
  }
}

# Save results
saveRDS(hybrid_results, "mRMR_hybrid_results.rds")
````

````{r}
# Load the saved hybrid results
hybrid_res <- readRDS("mRMR_hybrid_results.rds")

# Function to summarize feature sets for each dataset and method
summarize_features <- function(hybrid_list) {
  for (method in names(hybrid_list)) {
    cat("\n=== Method:", method, "===\n")
    for (dataset in names(hybrid_list[[method]])) {
      features <- hybrid_list[[method]][[dataset]]
      cat("Dataset:", dataset, 
          "| Selected features:", length(features), "\n")
      if(length(features) > 0) {
        cat("First 10 features:", paste(features[1:min(10, length(features))], collapse = ", "), "\n")
      } else {
        cat("No features selected!\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

# Run the summary
summarize_features(hybrid_res)
````

## (5) Classification with Logistic Regression


#Rest of the Methods
````{r}
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)

# -----------------------------
# Function to train logistic regression and evaluate
# -----------------------------
train_logistic <- function(dataset_name, split_data, feature_list, method_name) {
  
  features <- feature_list[[method_name]][[dataset_name]]
  if(length(features) < 2){
    warning("Too few features for logistic regression in ", dataset_name, " with ", method_name)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Subset train/test
  x_train <- t(split_data[[dataset_name]]$train_expr[features, , drop = FALSE])
  x_test  <- t(split_data[[dataset_name]]$test_expr[features, , drop = FALSE])
  y_train <- split_data[[dataset_name]]$train_labels
  y_test  <- split_data[[dataset_name]]$test_labels
  
  # Train logistic regression (ridge)
  log_model <- cv.glmnet(as.matrix(x_train), y_train, family="binomial", alpha=0)
  
  # Predict probabilities
  prob_train <- predict(log_model, newx=as.matrix(x_train), s="lambda.min", type="response")
  prob_test  <- predict(log_model, newx=as.matrix(x_test), s="lambda.min", type="response")
  
  # Predict classes
  pred_train <- factor(ifelse(prob_train > 0.5, "Tumor", "Normal"), levels=c("Normal","Tumor"))
  pred_test  <- factor(ifelse(prob_test > 0.5, "Tumor", "Normal"), levels=c("Normal","Tumor"))
  
  # Confusion matrices
  cm_train <- confusionMatrix(pred_train, y_train)
  cm_test  <- confusionMatrix(pred_test, y_test)
  
  # AUC
  auc_train <- roc(response = y_train, predictor = as.numeric(prob_train))$auc
  auc_test  <- roc(response = y_test, predictor = as.numeric(prob_test))$auc
  
  list(
    model = log_model,
    cm_train = cm_train,
    cm_test = cm_test,
    auc_train = auc_train,
    auc_test = auc_test,
    prob_train = prob_train,
    prob_test = prob_test
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Loop over all datasets and methods
# -----------------------------
methods <- c("sPLS","RFE","LASSO")
results_all <- list()

for(dataset in names(split_data)){
  cat("\n=== Dataset:", dataset, "===\n")
  results_all[[dataset]] <- list()
  for(method in methods){
    cat("Training logistic regression using", method, "features...\n")
    res <- train_logistic(dataset, split_data, hybrid_res, method)
    results_all[[dataset]][[method]] <- res
  }
}

# -----------------------------
# Example: Check Lung sPLS results
# -----------------------------
results_all$Lung$sPLS$cm_test
results_all$Lung$sPLS$auc_test


````


````{r}
library(dplyr)
library(pROC)
set.seed(1996)

# Ensure metrics function is defined
calculate_metrics <- function(pred_prob, true_labels) {
  true_labels <- factor(true_labels, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"))
  pred_class <- factor(ifelse(pred_prob > 0.5, "Tumor", "Normal"), levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"))
  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_class, true_labels, positive = "Tumor")
  
  roc_obj <- roc(response = true_labels, predictor = as.numeric(pred_prob), levels = rev(levels(true_labels)))
  
  as.data.frame(list(
    Accuracy = as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]),
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj)),
    Precision = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]),
    Sensitivity = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    Specificity = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]),
    F1 = as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
  ))
}

# -----------------------------
# Create summary table
# -----------------------------
summary_metrics <- data.frame()
methods <- c("sPLS","RFE","LASSO")

for(dataset in names(results_all)){
  for(method in methods){
    res <- results_all[[dataset]][[method]]
    if(is.null(res)) next
    
    pred_prob <- res$prob_test
    true_labels <- split_data[[dataset]]$test_labels
    
    metrics <- calculate_metrics(pred_prob, true_labels)
    metrics$Dataset <- dataset
    metrics$Method <- method
    
    summary_metrics <- rbind(summary_metrics, metrics)
  }
}

# Reorder columns
summary_metrics <- summary_metrics[, c("Dataset","Method","Accuracy","AUC","Precision","Sensitivity","Specificity","F1")]

# Rename Methods for clarity
summary_metrics$Method <- recode(summary_metrics$Method,
                                 "sPLS"  = "mRMR+sPLS",
                                 "RFE"   = "mRMR+RFE",
                                 "LASSO" = "mRMR+LASSO")

# -----------------------------
# Save results safely
# -----------------------------
saveRDS(summary_metrics, file = "summary_metrics.rds")   # RDS for R
write.csv(summary_metrics, "summary_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)  # CSV for Excel
# Optional: Excel file
# library(writexl)
# write_xlsx(summary_metrics, path = "summary_metrics.xlsx")

# Print table
print(summary_metrics)
````

#VISUALISATION
````{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Collect data for plotting
all_df <- data.frame()

for(nm in names(mRMR_results)){
  top_feats <- mRMR_results[[nm]]
  x_train <- t(split_data[[nm]]$train_expr)  # transpose for variance calculation
  
  # Compute variance per feature
  feat_vars <- apply(x_train, 2, var)
  
  # Keep only valid features present in top_feats
  valid_feats <- intersect(top_feats, names(feat_vars))
  
  # Build dataset-specific dataframe
  df_tmp <- data.frame(
    Dataset = nm,
    Feature = valid_feats,
    Rank = seq_along(valid_feats),
    Variance = feat_vars[valid_feats]
  )
  
  all_df <- bind_rows(all_df, df_tmp)
}

# Faceted scatter plot
p_faceted <- ggplot(all_df, aes(x = Rank, y = Variance)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkred", alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Dataset, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Variance vs. Rank for mRMR-Selected Features",
    x = "Feature Rank",
    y = "Feature Variance"
  )

print(p_faceted)

````

````{r}
# Calculate consistency scores
consistency_data <- summary_metrics %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_AUC = mean(AUC),
    SD_AUC = sd(AUC),
    Min_AUC = min(AUC),
    Max_AUC = max(AUC),
    Consistency_Score = 1 - (SD_AUC / Mean_AUC)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_AUC))

# Plot consistency
ggplot(consistency_data, aes(x = reorder(Method, Mean_AUC), y = Mean_AUC, fill = Method)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean_AUC - SD_AUC, ymax = Mean_AUC + SD_AUC),
    width = 0.2, color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("Consistency: ", round(Consistency_Score, 3))),
    hjust = -0.1, size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FF6B6B", "#4ECDC4", "#45B7D1")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Method Consistency Across Datasets",
    x = "Method",
    y = "Mean AUC ± SD",
    caption = "Error bars represent standard deviation across datasets"
  ) +
  coord_flip()
````

````{r}
    Avg_Accuracy    = mean(Accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),

    Avg_AUC         = mean(AUC, na.rm = TRUE),
````

````{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(gridExtra)

# Define colors for the three methods
method_colors <- c("#FF6B6B", "#4ECDC4", "#45B7D1") # sPLS, RFE, LASSO

# Create radar plot data
create_radar_data <- function(performance_df){
  radar_data <- performance_df %>%
    dplyr::select(Dataset, Method, Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity, F1, AUC) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity, F1, AUC),
                        names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
    group_by(Dataset, Metric) %>%
    mutate(Value_scaled = (Value - min(Value)) / (max(Value) - min(Value))) %>%
    ungroup()
  radar_data$Metric <- factor(radar_data$Metric, levels = c("Accuracy","Sensitivity","Specificity","F1","AUC"))
  return(radar_data)
}

radar_data <- create_radar_data(summary_metrics)  # Use summary_metrics

# Generate plots
radar_plots <- list()
for(dataset in unique(radar_data$Dataset)){
  plot_data <- radar_data %>% filter(Dataset == dataset)
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Metric, y = Value_scaled, group = Method, color = Method)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_polygon(aes(fill = Method), alpha = 0.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
    coord_polar() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Performance Radar -", dataset), x = "", y = "Scaled Performance") +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
  radar_plots[[dataset]] <- p
}

# Arrange radar plots in a grid
gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = radar_plots, ncol = 2)
````

````{r}
    cols = Accuracy:AUC,   # This now includes Precision automatically
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# Create boxplot
ggplot(boxplot_data, aes(x = Method, y = Value, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_y") +

       y = "Metric Value") +
````

````{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Function to create a normalized performance heatmap
create_performance_heatmap <- function(summary_table) {
  
  # Ensure numeric metrics exist
  numeric_cols <- c("Accuracy", "Precision", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "F1", "AUC")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(numeric_cols, colnames(summary_table))
  if(length(missing_cols) > 0){
    stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # Reshape to long format
  heatmap_data <- summary_table %>%
    dplyr::select(Dataset, Method, all_of(numeric_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(numeric_cols),
      names_to = "Metric",
      values_to = "Value"
    )
  
  # Normalize each metric across all datasets and methods (0-1 scale)
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
    group_by(Metric) %>%
    mutate(Normalized = (Value - min(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                        (max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(Value, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Optional: order methods consistently
  heatmap_data$Method <- factor(heatmap_data$Method, levels = c("mRMR+sPLS", "mRMR+RFE", "mRMR+LASSO"))
  
  # Order y-axis by Dataset first, then Metric
  heatmap_data$Dataset_Metric <- factor(
    paste(heatmap_data$Dataset, heatmap_data$Metric, sep = " - "),
    levels = unique(paste(heatmap_data$Dataset, heatmap_data$Metric, sep = " - "))
  )
  
  # Plot heatmap
  ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = Method, y = Dataset_Metric, fill = Normalized)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Value, 3)), color = "white", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues")) +
    labs(
      title = "Performance Comparison: sPLS vs RFE vs LASSO",
      subtitle = "Across all datasets and metrics (colors normalized per metric)",
      x = "Method",
      y = "Dataset & Metric",
      fill = "Normalized"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

# Create and display the heatmap
performance_heatmap <- create_performance_heatmap(summary_metrics)
print(performance_heatmap)
````

```{r}
# ================================================================
# Additional Classifiers with mRMR+RFE Features
# ================================================================
library(e1071)   # Naive Bayes
library(kernlab) # SVM
library(caret)
library(pROC)
set.seed(1996)

additional_results <- data.frame()

for(nm in names(split_data)) {
  
  # Use only features selected by mRMR + RFE
  features <- hybrid_res[["RFE"]][[nm]]
  
  if(is.null(features) || length(features) < 2){
    warning("Too few features for dataset ", nm, "- skipping additional classifiers.")
    next
  }
  
  # Subset train/test matrices
  x_train <- t(split_data[[nm]]$train_expr[features, , drop = FALSE])
  y_train <- split_data[[nm]]$train_labels
  x_test  <- t(split_data[[nm]]$test_expr[features, , drop = FALSE])
  y_test  <- split_data[[nm]]$test_labels
  
  train_df <- data.frame(Class = y_train, x_train)
  test_df  <- data.frame(x_test)
  
  # -------------------------
  # SVM Classifier
  # -------------------------
  svm_model <- ksvm(x = as.matrix(x_train), y = y_train,
                    type = "C-svc", kernel = "rbfdot", prob.model = TRUE)
  
  svm_probs <- predict(svm_model, as.matrix(x_test), type = "probabilities")[,"Tumor"]
  svm_pred  <- factor(ifelse(svm_probs > 0.5, "Tumor", "Normal"), levels = c("Normal","Tumor"))
  
  svm_roc <- roc(y_test, svm_probs)
  
  additional_results <- rbind(additional_results, data.frame(
    Dataset = nm,
    Classifier = "SVM",
    Accuracy = mean(svm_pred == y_test),
    Precision = posPredValue(svm_pred, y_test, positive = "Tumor"),
    Recall = sensitivity(svm_pred, y_test),
    Specificity = specificity(svm_pred, y_test),
    F1 = F_meas(svm_pred, y_test),
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(svm_roc))
  ))
  
  # -------------------------
  # Naive Bayes Classifier
  # -------------------------
  nb_model <- naiveBayes(Class ~ ., data = train_df)
  
  nb_probs <- predict(nb_model, test_df, type = "raw")[,"Tumor"]
  nb_pred  <- factor(ifelse(nb_probs > 0.5, "Tumor", "Normal"), levels = c("Normal","Tumor"))
  
  nb_roc <- roc(y_test, nb_probs)
  
  additional_results <- rbind(additional_results, data.frame(
    Dataset = nm,
    Classifier = "NaiveBayes",
    Accuracy = mean(nb_pred == y_test),
    Precision = posPredValue(nb_pred, y_test, positive = "Tumor"),
    Recall = sensitivity(nb_pred, y_test),
    Specificity = specificity(nb_pred, y_test),
    F1 = F_meas(nb_pred, y_test),
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(nb_roc))
  ))
}

# -------------------------
# After loop: reorder, save, print
# -------------------------
additional_results <- additional_results[, c("Dataset","Classifier","Accuracy","Precision","Recall","Specificity","F1","AUC")]

saveRDS(additional_results, "additional_classifiers_RFE.rds")
write.csv(additional_results, "additional_classifiers_RFE.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(additional_results)
```

````{r}
  features <- hybrid_res[["RFE"]][[nm]]
  
  if(is.null(features) || length(features) < 2){
    warning("Too few features for dataset ", nm, "- skipping additional classifiers.")
    next
  }
  
  x_train <- t(split_data[[nm]]$train_expr[features, , drop = FALSE])
  x_test  <- t(split_data[[nm]]$test_expr[features, , drop = FALSE])

  y_test  <- split_data[[nm]]$test_labels
  
  train_df <- data.frame(Class = y_train, x_train)

  # --- SVM ---
  svm_model <- ksvm(as.matrix(x_train), y_train,
                    type = "C-svc", kernel = "rbfdot", prob.model = TRUE)
  svm_probs <- predict(svm_model, as.matrix(x_test), type = "probabilities")[,"Tumor"]

    Recall = sensitivity(svm_pred, y_test),
    Specificity = specificity(svm_pred, y_test),
    F1 = F_meas(svm_pred, y_test),
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(svm_roc))
  ))
  
  # --- Naive Bayes ---
  nb_model <- naiveBayes(Class ~ ., data = train_df)
  nb_probs <- predict(nb_model, test_df, type = "raw")[,"Tumor"]
  nb_pred  <- factor(ifelse(nb_probs > 0.5, "Tumor", "Normal"), levels = c("Normal","Tumor"))
  nb_roc   <- roc(y_test, nb_probs)
  
  additional_results <- rbind(additional_results, data.frame(
    Dataset = nm,
    Classifier = "NaiveBayes",
    Accuracy = mean(nb_pred == y_test),
    Precision = posPredValue(nb_pred, y_test, positive = "Tumor"),
    Recall = sensitivity(nb_pred, y_test),
    Specificity = specificity(nb_pred, y_test),
    F1 = F_meas(nb_pred, y_test),
    AUC = as.numeric(auc(nb_roc))
  ))
}

# -------------------------
````

````{r}
set.seed(1996)
library(kernlab)
library(e1071)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)

# Initialize a dataframe to hold all ROC curves and metrics
roc_combined_df <- data.frame()
metrics_df      <- data.frame()

for(nm in names(split_data)) {
  
  # Use only top mRMR+LASSO features
  features <- hybrid_res[["LASSO"]][[nm]]
  if(is.null(features) || length(features) < 2) next
  
  # Subset train/test matrices
  x_train <- t(split_data[[nm]]$train_expr[features, , drop = FALSE])
  y_train <- split_data[[nm]]$train_labels
  x_test  <- t(split_data[[nm]]$test_expr[features, , drop = FALSE])
  y_test  <- split_data[[nm]]$test_labels
  
  df_list <- list()
  
  # -------------------------
  # Logistic Regression
  # -------------------------
  log_model <- suppressWarnings(
    glm(Class ~ ., data = data.frame(Class = y_train, x_train), family = "binomial")
  )
  log_prob <- predict(log_model, newdata = data.frame(x_test), type = "response")
  log_pred <- factor(ifelse(log_prob > 0.5, "Tumor", "Normal"), levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"))
  
  # ROC data
  roc_obj <- roc(y_test, log_prob, quiet = TRUE)
  df_list[["Logistic"]] <- data.frame(
    Dataset = nm,
    Specificity = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    Sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    Classifier = "Logistic"
  )
  
  # Metrics
  metrics_df <- rbind(metrics_df, data.frame(
    Dataset   = nm,
    Classifier= "Logistic",
    Accuracy  = mean(log_pred == y_test),
    Precision = posPredValue(log_pred, y_test, positive = "Tumor"),
    Recall    = sensitivity(log_pred, y_test),
    Specificity = specificity(log_pred, y_test),
    F1        = F_meas(log_pred, y_test),
    AUC       = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  ))
  
  # -------------------------
  # SVM
  # -------------------------
  svm_model <- ksvm(as.matrix(x_train), y_train, type = "C-svc", kernel = "rbfdot", prob.model = TRUE)
  svm_prob  <- predict(svm_model, as.matrix(x_test), type = "probabilities")[,"Tumor"]
  svm_pred  <- factor(ifelse(svm_prob > 0.5, "Tumor", "Normal"), levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"))
  
  roc_obj <- roc(y_test, svm_prob, quiet = TRUE)
  df_list[["SVM"]] <- data.frame(
    Dataset = nm,
    Specificity = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    Sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    Classifier = "SVM"
  )
  
  metrics_df <- rbind(metrics_df, data.frame(
    Dataset   = nm,
    Classifier= "SVM",
    Accuracy  = mean(svm_pred == y_test),
    Precision = posPredValue(svm_pred, y_test, positive = "Tumor"),
    Recall    = sensitivity(svm_pred, y_test),
    Specificity = specificity(svm_pred, y_test),
    F1        = F_meas(svm_pred, y_test),
    AUC       = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  ))
  
  # -------------------------
  # Naive Bayes
  # -------------------------
  nb_model <- naiveBayes(Class ~ ., data = data.frame(Class = y_train, x_train))
  nb_prob  <- predict(nb_model, data.frame(x_test), type = "raw")[,"Tumor"]
  nb_pred  <- factor(ifelse(nb_prob > 0.5, "Tumor", "Normal"), levels = c("Normal", "Tumor"))
  
  roc_obj <- roc(y_test, nb_prob, quiet = TRUE)
  df_list[["NaiveBayes"]] <- data.frame(
    Dataset = nm,
    Specificity = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    Sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    Classifier = "NaiveBayes"
  )
  
  metrics_df <- rbind(metrics_df, data.frame(
    Dataset   = nm,
    Classifier= "NaiveBayes",
    Accuracy  = mean(nb_pred == y_test),
    Precision = posPredValue(nb_pred, y_test, positive = "Tumor"),
    Recall    = sensitivity(nb_pred, y_test),
    Specificity = specificity(nb_pred, y_test),
    F1        = F_meas(nb_pred, y_test),
    AUC       = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  ))
  
  # Combine ROC curves for this dataset
  roc_combined_df <- rbind(roc_combined_df, do.call(rbind, df_list))
}

# -------------------------
# Faceted ROC Plot
# -------------------------
ggplot(roc_combined_df, aes(x = Specificity, y = Sensitivity, color = Classifier)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Dataset) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "ROC Curves by Dataset (Top Features: mRMR+LASSO)",
       x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Logistic" = "#FF6B6B",
                                "SVM" = "#4ECDC4",
                                "NaiveBayes" = "#45B7D1")) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Save metrics for downstream use
saveRDS(metrics_df, "additional_classifiers_LASSO_metrics.rds")
write.csv(metrics_df, "additional_classifiers_LASSO_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Print metrics
print(metrics_df)
````

````{r}
  mutate(Classifier = case_when(

  geom_line(position = position_dodge(0.3), size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_AUC - 1.96 * SE_AUC, ymax = Mean_AUC + 1.96 * SE_AUC),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Logistic" = "#E41A1C",  # red
    "SVM"      = "#377EB8",  # blue
    "NaiveBayes" = "#4DAF4A" # green
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Mean AUC ± 95% CI by Classifier and Dataset",
    x = "Dataset",
    y = "Mean AUC ± 95% CI"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
````

````{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(gridExtra) # optional for spacing control

create_shap_dependence_faceted <- function(shap_results, importance_data, n_features = 3) {
  
  # Build long-format SHAP + feature values
  shap_long_data <- map_dfr(names(shap_results), function(dataset_name) {
    res <- shap_results[[dataset_name]]
    if (is.null(res)) return(data.frame())
    
    # SHAP long
    shap_df <- as.data.frame(res$shap_matrix)
    shap_df$Sample <- rownames(shap_df)
    shap_long <- shap_df %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -Sample, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "SHAP")
    
    # Feature long
    feature_df <- as.data.frame(res$feature_values)
    feature_df$Sample <- rownames(feature_df)
    feature_long <- feature_df %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -Sample, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Feature_Value")
    
    # Merge
    inner_join(shap_long, feature_long, by = c("Sample", "Feature")) %>%
      mutate(Dataset = dataset_name)
  })
  
  # Select top n_features per dataset
  top_features <- importance_data %>%
    group_by(Dataset) %>%
    filter(Rank <= n_features) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  dependence_data <- shap_long_data %>%
    inner_join(top_features, by = c("Dataset", "Feature"))
  
  if (nrow(dependence_data) == 0) {
    warning("No matching features found.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Create a combined label for facetting (2x2 layout)
  dependence_data <- dependence_data %>%
    mutate(Facet_Label = paste0(Dataset, " | ", Feature))
  
  # Generate plot
  p <- ggplot(dependence_data, aes(x = Feature_Value, y = SHAP)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "red", se = FALSE, size = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~Facet_Label, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("SHAP Dependence Plots - Top ", n_features, " Features per Dataset"),
      x = "Feature Value",
      y = "SHAP Value (Impact on Prediction)"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
    )
  
  return(list(plot = p, data = dependence_data))
}

# Usage example
result <- create_shap_dependence_faceted(shap_results, importance_data, n_features = 3)
print(result$plot)
ggsave("SHAP_dependence_faceted.png", result$plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
````

````{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 4. FACETED: Cross-dataset Consensus Heatmap
consensus_heatmap_data <- importance_data %>%
  filter(Rank <= 15) %>%            # Top 15 genes from each dataset
  mutate(Importance_Score = 1 / Rank)  # Convert rank to score (lower rank = higher score)

# Heatmap plot
p_consensus <- ggplot(consensus_heatmap_data,
                      aes(x = Dataset,
                          y = reorder(Feature, Mean_ABS_SHAP),
                          fill = Importance_Score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Rank), color = "white", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FEE08B", high = "#D73027",
                      name = "Importance\nScore") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top Gene Importance Across All Datasets",
       subtitle = "Ranking of most important genes (Lower number = More Important)",
       x = "Dataset",
       y = "Gene") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

print(p_consensus)

# Save figure
ggsave("Consensus_Heatmap_Top15Genes.png", p_consensus, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
````

````{r}
) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +

  ) +

    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
````
